name: Closed Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the closed status.

ASIN.name: Account Servicer Instruction
ASIN.definition: Account is closed, following an instruction from the account servicer to close the account.

CLIN.name: Client Instruction
CLIN.definition: Account is closed, following an instruction from the client, or an authorised party, to close the account.
